title: WaterTreks EcoTours
specs: Wildlife includes seals and pups, sea birds, river otter, fox, bobcat, mink, muskrat, sea lions, whales, dolphins, pelagic birds, brown and American white pelicans
Bioluminescent plankton night tours available mid June to October
Located in a biologically dense and diverse coastal habitat with state, federal, and UN protections
All participants must have swimming skills
Children under 12 are half price; children 3 to 5 free with one per adult
Dogs must be wildlife friendly and pay $10; not allowed on Goat Rock or Driftwood Beaches
Under 10 not allowed on join our group plankton night tours; younger children may join private family plankton tours
No fishing within estuary or off shore wildlife nurseries
Large groups should reserve a month in advance
Group tours mostly in double kayaks

blurb: Guests kayak in the Russian River Estuary and along the Sonoma Coast to view wildlife such as seals, sea birds, otters, and pelicans. Rentals include beginner-friendly kayaks with safety gear and interpretation. Private and group guided tours offer various durations and include education on local ecology and wildlife.
